paragraphs: Fire ant control should go beyond knocking down the mounds you can see. Grow Green combines visible mound treatment with colony-focused control designed for South Louisiana lawns.
Send us your property information and our team will get your fire ant treatment quote started.
Thanks! Your fire ant estimate request has been sent directly to our team. We’ll be in touch soon.

A few visible mounds can quickly become a frustrating problem around play areas, walkways, pets and the places your family spends time outside. Treating only what appears above ground can leave the larger colony problem unaddressed.
Fire ants aggressively defend disturbed colonies, making active areas of the lawn uncomfortable for people and pets.
Visible mounds are useful signs of activity, but the goal is controlling the colony rather than treating appearances alone.
South Louisiana conditions can create continued fire ant pressure, which is why timing and a proactive approach matter.
The program is designed around professional treatment, colony control and properly timed follow-up rather than waiting until mounds become a major nuisance.
We evaluate visible fire ant activity and the areas where colonies are creating the most immediate concern.
Visible problem areas can be addressed while the broader treatment strategy is used to target fire ant activity across the lawn.
Properly timed service helps reduce fire ant pressure before your lawn is covered with new active mounds again.
Homeowners often get stuck in a cycle of treating one mound, waiting for another to appear, and starting over. Professional control takes a broader view.
You see a mound, treat a mound and repeat the process whenever another problem appears.
Our service is designed to address existing fire ant activity while putting broader pressure on colonies throughout the treated area.
You shouldn’t have to chase down a lawn company just to understand what happens next. We keep the process straightforward.
Give us your address and contact information so our office can prepare your fire ant service quote.
Once you’re ready to move forward, we get your property into the appropriate service schedule.
Your technician performs the scheduled fire ant treatment using the appropriate application strategy for the service.
The goal is a lawn where you spend less time hunting individual mounds and more time actually enjoying your property.
Treatments are applied according to product label directions. Follow any re-entry or post-treatment instructions provided by your technician before people or pets return to treated areas.
Grow Green Weed Control is a local lawn treatment company serving homeowners throughout the Baton Rouge area, including communities across Ascension and Livingston.
Fire ant treatment pairs naturally with your lawn fertilization and weed control program, making it easier to manage more of your lawn through one local team.

faqs.a: No. Visible mounds are important signs of activity, but our approach is designed around broader fire ant and colony control rather than simply treating one visible mound at a time.

faqs.q: How many fire ant treatments will my lawn need? +
faqs.a: Treatment frequency depends on the service program and fire ant pressure on the property. Our team can explain the recommended service schedule with your estimate.

faqs.q: Will I never see another fire ant after treatment? +
faqs.a: No outdoor treatment can permanently prevent every new fire ant from entering a property. The goal of a professional program is to dramatically reduce colony pressure and keep activity more manageable over time.

We apply professional products according to their label directions. Follow the specific re-entry and post-treatment instructions provided for your service before allowing people or pets back into treated areas.

faqs.q: Can I add fire ant treatment to my lawn program? +
faqs.a: Yes. Fire ant treatment can be paired with Grow Green lawn fertilization and weed control so you can manage both services through the same local team.
Grow Green serves the Greater Baton Rouge area, including many communities throughout Ascension Parish and Livingston Parish. Submit your address and our team can confirm service availability.

WHY FIRE ANTS ARE DIFFERENT============================================================ -->
The mound is only the part you see. Effective fire ant management focuses on colony activity, not simply flattening visible mounds.
More Than A Mound Problem

Fire ants can turn a good lawn into a yard nobody wants to use.

A few visible mounds can quickly become a frustrating problem around play areas, walkways, pets and the places your family spends time outside. Treating only what appears above ground can leave the larger colony problem unaddressed.

01

Painful stings

Fire ants aggressively defend disturbed colonies, making active areas of the lawn uncomfortable for people and pets.

02

Colonies you may not notice

Visible mounds are useful signs of activity, but the goal is controlling the colony rather than treating appearances alone.

03

Ongoing pressure

South Louisiana conditions can create continued fire ant pressure, which is why timing and a proactive approach matter.

HOW OUR PROGRAM WORKS============================================================ -->
Our Approach

We target the problem above ground and below it.

The program is designed around professional treatment, colony control and properly timed follow-up rather than waiting until mounds become a major nuisance.

1

Inspect the lawn

We evaluate visible fire ant activity and the areas where colonies are creating the most immediate concern.

2

Treat active pressure

Visible problem areas can be addressed while the broader treatment strategy is used to target fire ant activity across the lawn.

3

Stay ahead of reinvasion

Properly timed service helps reduce fire ant pressure before your lawn is covered with new active mounds again.

MOUND TREATMENT VS PROGRAM============================================================ -->
Why The Approach Matters

Killing one mound isn’t the same as controlling fire ants across your lawn.

Homeowners often get stuck in a cycle of treating one mound, waiting for another to appear, and starting over. Professional control takes a broader view.

Mound-Only Approach

Reactive control

You see a mound, treat a mound and repeat the process whenever another problem appears.

  • – Focuses primarily on visible activity
  • – Requires repeated homeowner monitoring
  • – Can become an ongoing game of whack-a-mole
Grow Green Approach

Lawn-wide fire ant management

Our service is designed to address existing fire ant activity while putting broader pressure on colonies throughout the treated area.

  • ✓ Visible mound and activity assessment
  • ✓ Colony-focused treatment strategy
  • ✓ Professional products and timing
  • ✓ Ongoing program instead of waiting for major pressure
WHAT TO EXPECT============================================================ -->
What To Expect

Simple from estimate to treatment.

You shouldn’t have to chase down a lawn company just to understand what happens next. We keep the process straightforward.

Enjoy your yard with less fire ant pressure

The goal is a lawn where you spend less time hunting individual mounds and more time actually enjoying your property.

FAQs============================================================ -->
Fire Ant FAQs

Questions before you get started?

Here are some of the most common questions homeowners have about professional fire ant treatment.

Do you treat only the fire ant mounds I can see? +
No. Visible mounds are important signs of activity, but our approach is designed around broader fire ant and colony control rather than simply treating one visible mound at a time.
How many fire ant treatments will my lawn need? +
Treatment frequency depends on the service program and fire ant pressure on the property. Our team can explain the recommended service schedule with your estimate.
Will I never see another fire ant after treatment? +
No outdoor treatment can permanently prevent every new fire ant from entering a property. The goal of a professional program is to dramatically reduce colony pressure and keep activity more manageable over time.
What about children and pets? +
We apply professional products according to their label directions. Follow the specific re-entry and post-treatment instructions provided for your service before allowing people or pets back into treated areas.
Can I add fire ant treatment to my lawn program? +
Yes. Fire ant treatment can be paired with Grow Green lawn fertilization and weed control so you can manage both services through the same local team.
What areas do you service? +
Grow Green serves the Greater Baton Rouge area, including many communities throughout Ascension Parish and Livingston Parish. Submit your address and our team can confirm service availability.
